contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Generate supported business behavior. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.

Enable a system builder to generate supported typed business behavior from checked source models using explicitly selected realization profiles, while retaining source identity and unsupported residue.
acceptance_conditions: Business meaning remains in the checked source and original semantic owners.
Only declarations admitted by the selected compiler/profile path are generated; required unsupported constructs reject or remain explicit residue.
Generated behavior and provenance bind the selected source, profile and package tuple.
Pure outputs and state-changing behavior retain distinct contracts and permission boundaries.
exclusions: Arbitrary natural-language interpretation or arbitrary target languages
Uniform support across all language/profile combinations
Fresh semantic/runtime qualification or owner adoption from generation alone

contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Generate selected applications and services. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.

Enable a system builder to generate supported application/service implementations and their assembly from checked business input and explicit technical profiles, preserving original runtime owners and required host resources.
acceptance_conditions: Generated entry points originate in declared business/public intents and retain explicit authorization policy.
Selected handlers, transactions, workflows and native owners retain their actual ABI/resource bindings.
Application graphs/bridges preserve source and original-owner provenance.
Unsupported joins reject rather than generating a claimed universal application.
exclusions: Universal application composition or all-34 Lab API qualification
Provider account setup, deployment, host/resource lifecycle or real-provider completion inferred from generated source
Production Auth, full process-crash qualification or measured model quality from recorded fixtures

contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Generate contracts, SDKs and traceability views. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.
Enable builders and reviewers to obtain checked contract data, supported client/service interfaces and source-linked business/system views from the same selected application/model inputs.
acceptance_conditions: Contract data and generated SDK/view artifacts preserve exact selected schema/source identities.
Generated business/system graphs and bridges retain original owners and artifact joins.
Views remain derived representations and do not grant authority.
exclusions: Every possible client language/transport or a generated SDK for an arbitrary API
Generated graphs as runtime/conformance or owner-admission proof

contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Export supported formal models. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.
Enable a reviewer to export supported bounded source models into established formal-language representations with explicit scope and provenance for separate analysis.
acceptance_conditions: Exports identify their selected source/profile/model bounds.
Ordinary code generation remains available without formal claims or export.
Exporting model text never implies solver success, TDE/EVF execution or owner admission.
exclusions: Automatic proof, satisfiability or solver/provider execution from export alone
An established TDE-to-EVF join or whole-system theorem
